capabilities.name: Document loading and media types
capabilities.covered: Standalone PDF readiness, image fixture loading and unsupported-media diagnostics
capabilities.gap: AAT document loading and Word/audio/video journeys are not yet Playwright functional coverage

capabilities.name: Page navigation
capabilities.covered: Next/previous, page input, rendered page identity, viewport state and document boundaries
capabilities.gap: Bundle and nested-document index navigation remains legacy-only

capabilities.name: Zoom
capabilities.covered: PDF/image round-trip and minimum/maximum scale boundaries
capabilities.gap: No remaining high-value gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: Rotation
capabilities.covered: PDF orientation and image transform round-trips
capabilities.gap: Persistence across document reload remains to be proven

capabilities.name: Search
capabilities.covered: Positive search, next/previous, no results, close/reset, recovery and Enter navigation
capabilities.gap: Advanced search options—highlight all, exact case and whole word—remain untested

capabilities.name: Comments panel
capabilities.covered: Playwright functional coverage for direct-toolbar panel lifecycle; create, update, removal and cancel semantics; immediate and rehydrated rendered state; stale-highlight reset, no-result and multi-result search; cross-page search navigation; rendered comment summary and page-link navigation; and document-isolated comment persistence
capabilities.gap: Comment creation from a real PDF text selection and the non-blank summary journey remain legacy coverage

capabilities.name: PDF annotations and comments
capabilities.covered: Codecept coverage exists for PDF text/box highlights, comment creation, rotated-document comments, search annotation, multiple comments and highlight removal
capabilities.gap: Playwright functional coverage for PDF annotation creation, search annotation and removal remains to be migrated

capabilities.name: Image annotations and comments
capabilities.covered: Codecept coverage exists for image draw-box and non-textual comments
capabilities.gap: No Playwright functional coverage for image annotation persistence or lifecycle

capabilities.name: Bookmarks
capabilities.covered: Playwright covers real text-selection contextual bookmark creation, panel creation, update, delete with sibling promotion, single and multiple empty drafts, document-position/custom sorting and 30-bookmark lifecycle with deterministic bookmark API fixtures; the rendered reorder regression remains discoverable as an intentionally skipped test
capabilities.gap: Rendered bookmark order after drag persistence is blocked by EXUI-5097; re-enable the skipped reorder test after the product fix is delivered and verified in AAT/preview

capabilities.name: Index and outline
capabilities.covered: Codecept coverage exists for bundle and nested-document navigation
capabilities.gap: No Playwright functional coverage for index, outline or attachment selection

capabilities.name: Print and download
capabilities.covered: Codecept coverage exists for PDF download and print initiation
capabilities.gap: No Playwright assertion of downloaded binary identity or print contract

capabilities.name: Redaction
capabilities.covered: Codecept coverage exists for draw-box, text, search, preview, save and removal journeys
capabilities.gap: No Playwright coverage of redaction state, preview or saved output

capabilities.name: Multimedia playback
capabilities.covered: Codecept coverage exists for audio play/stop and pause/rewind intent
capabilities.gap: No Playwright coverage of audio/video controls or playback state
